title: Subjective features belong to the real world like everything else

statements.text: The way out of the mind and body puzzle is to move the ontologically subjective features, such as qualitativeness and subjectivity, to the side of the real world, drop the labels mental and physical, and say these features are parts of the real world like everything else.

sources.quote: Move the ontologically subjective features on the left hand side over to the right hand side.
are parts of the real world just like everything else
